# Vendored libraries

| Folder or file | What | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sql-wasm.js`, `sql-wasm.wasm` | sql.js (SQLite in the browser) | MIT |
| `leaflet.js`, `leaflet.css`, `images/` | Leaflet 2D maps | BSD-2-Clause |
| `cesium/` | CesiumJS 1.147 (3D globe), including its Natural Earth II offline imagery | Apache-2.0 (see `cesium/LICENSE.md`) |

The 3D ship models in `web/models/` are generated by `scripts/generate_ship_models.py`.
The optional satellite layer streams Esri World Imagery tiles and shows its attribution on the globe.
